basic_info.description: Gramercy Towers is a highly sought-after condominium community perched atop San Francisco's iconic Nob Hill, offering timeless elegance in one of the city's most prestigious neighborhoods. Unit 212 has been thoughtfully and tastefully updated throughout. The kitchen features a stylish center island, updated lighting, and opens to a spacious, custom-designed dining areaperfect for entertaining. New hardwood floors extend seamlessly through the living, dining, and kitchen areas, enhancing the unit's warmth and sophistication.
